method.analysis: Offline existing twelve actual same-version/Profile pilot traces; no new runtime samples
method.mainFrameRendererThread: Previously verified by the unchanged official Meta+AnimationFrames handlers
method.events: Actual complete X events; durations in microseconds converted to milliseconds
method.inclusiveDurations: Contain nested events; retain these diagnostics but never interpret their sum as exclusive CPU cost
method.outermostSameNameDurations: Sort each stage by timestamp then decreasing duration; keep outermost same-name intervals only; fail on partial overlap rather than adding it
method.reportedThreadDurations: Actual tdur where present; missing values remain counted, never imputed as zero
method.normalization: Per actual trace second; stage names remain separate, never summed
method.clocks: Reported thread and wall clocks are distinct; some reported thread totals exceed wall totals, without being clamped or converted to CPU utilization

limits: This is the formal0.8.0 pilot, not the separate formal0.10.1 GPU-process or browser-restart study.
Whole-page main-renderer stages, not individual SVG shapes, JavaScript owners, raster workers, compositor or GPU cost.
Two short ordered repetitions per count; revision/count order and other desktop workloads remain uncontrolled.
Outermost same-name intervals still contain other stage names and nested work; never add stage totals.
Reported thread-clock precision and cross-clock differences are not qualified as CPU utilization.
Paint observations narrow the workload; no causal regression, owning-seam correction or performance acceptance is established.
